description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Earth 3 with Stacking], [Zenith Mode], [Zenith Mode: Tifa (Earth)] and [Damage Cap +10000] to the user

description.name: Zenith Mode: Tifa (Earth)
description.text: Increases [Earth Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for PHY attacks, Earth abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Tifa (Earth) after using a Earth ability (max 2), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Beat Rush+
description.text: Six single attacks (1.20/1.25 each) capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses

description.name: Somersault+
description.text: Four single attacks (1.10 each), grants [Monk Quick Cast 2] to the user

description.name: Spirit Attack: Tifa (Earth)
description.text: One single attack (5.34) capped at 99999, 6.00 if exploiting Earth weakness

description.name: Attach Earth 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Earth Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Earth 3

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
